cases.name: empty
cases.covers: Every field omitted: keep everything.

cases.name: null-clears
cases.covers: An explicit null is a clear, not an omission.

cases.name: value-sets
cases.covers: A value is a set.

cases.name: empty-string-is-a-set
cases.covers: An empty string sets the field to empty; it is not a clear.

cases.name: several-fields-at-once
cases.covers: All three states in one document.

cases.name: unknown-field
cases.covers: The schema is .strict(), so a typo is an error rather than a dropped key.

cases.name: wrong-type
cases.covers: A number where a string belongs.

cases.name: trapped-value
cases.covers: The tri-valued enum, set.

cases.name: trapped-null
cases.covers: trapped is .optional() without .nullable(): null is an error, not an omission.

cases.name: trapped-unknown-member
cases.covers: A value outside the enum.

cases.name: custom-empty
cases.covers: An empty map is a present map, not an absent one.

cases.name: custom-per-key-three-state
cases.covers: A key set, a key removed, and every other key left alone.

cases.name: custom-null
cases.covers: The map itself is two-state: there is no "clear the concept of custom entries".

cases.name: custom-empty-key
cases.covers: An empty key is a key. Whether the engine then rejects it is a different gate.

cases.name: created-millisecond-precision
cases.covers: The form iso_8601 emits.

cases.name: created-second-precision
cases.covers: No fractional part.

cases.name: created-microsecond-precision
cases.covers: zod allows any number of fractional digits.

cases.name: created-leap-day
cases.covers: February 29th in a leap year is a real date.

cases.name: created-impossible-date
cases.covers: February 30th is not, in any year.

cases.name: created-offset
cases.covers: zod datetime() defaults to offset: false, so only Z is accepted.

cases.name: created-not-a-date
cases.covers: An arbitrary string. A Patch<String> would take it; the schema does not.

cases.name: created-null
cases.covers: A date field is nullable, so null clears it.

cases.name: modified-not-a-date
cases.covers: The same rule on the second date field, in case only one was wired.
